title: Kombucha Overpressure Window
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kombucha:reading
| stats latest(pressure_kpa) as pressure, latest(temp_c) as temp by batch_id
| where pressure>180 OR temp>28
| sort - pressure
description: Watches kombucha batches for the pressure and temperature combination that suggests carbonation is moving from fun to explosive.
value: Fermentation projects rarely fail gently; a pressure watch helps you vent or chill a batch before the mess starts.
implementation: Forward pressure and temperature telemetry from the fermenter; alert when either crosses your safe bottling or storage threshold.
visualization: Batch table of kombucha pressure and temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when a kombucha batch is getting warm and pressurised enough that you should probably cool it or burp it soon.
